name: cross-telemetry-signal-reconciler
description: Reconciles health signals for the same service across CloudWatch and connected third-party telemetry (Datadog, Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana, New Relic), classifies disagreements, finds coverage gaps and duplicate alerting, and recommends a single source of truth per signal. Read-only.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on WED at 11:00 UTC
